digest.component_or_area: reconciler vendor adapter architecture and Jira Data Center backend
propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to document the jira_family sub-seam layer, two-level vendor adapter structure, and parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) rather than replaced entirely.

The TicketTransport contract declares six members but the core reconciler actually calls twenty-one distinct transport methods, with twelve absent from DC implementation and undetectable by mypy without type annotations, causing silent runtime failures.

RemoteRef.instance is intended design for deployment disambiguation but never constructed in production code, representing a gap that must be documented as unimplemented rather than asserted as existing.
The shared-jira provenance decision and backend-generalization scope must explicitly defer jira_key, jira- prefix, and channel vocabulary generalization to epic be74 when GitHub adapter lands.

Documentation must record the March 2029 Jira Data Center read-only horizon, framing this adapter as deliberately time-boxed investment for self-hosted clients with durable asset being the family seam.

User guide must establish DC least-privilege expectations (dedicated service account, scoped PAT), document allow_insecure, ca_bundle, and resolved_statuses configuration options, and demonstrate execution against real instance.
